value.text: {"result": {"suggestions": [{"kind": "existing_thesis", "pillar_id": "AAPL.p1", "stance": "contradicts", "relevance": 0.85, "strength": 2, "wrong_if_met": false, "assumptions": [], "street_view_shift": "none", "street_view_note": "The street rates AAPL a buy while the desk is short; a supply-chain channel check is not a sell-side move, so the street's view is unchanged, and the data runs against the desk's side.", "rationale": "The email reports first-hand supplier channel checks of pulled-forward and raised Pro Max panel orders and stretched touch IC lead times, which point to a stronger iPhone cycle than the pillar assumes; this is upstream order data rather than sell-through or reported lead-time data, so the wrong-if test is not clearly met.", "claim_ids": ["synthetic_000261.c1", "synthetic_000261.c2", "synthetic_000261.c4"], "sections": [{"email_id": "synthetic_000261", "quote": "Over the past three weeks, purchase orders for Pro Max-class panels have been pulled forward."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000261", "quote": "Two panel customers raised their December-quarter orders with us by roughly 9-12% versus the plan we had in early September, and one asked for expedited shipment of the October lot."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000261", "quote": "One customer told us the upward revision came from Apple's side after strong pre-order conversion in the U.S. and Japan, with fewer cancellations than last year."}]}], "no_change_reason": null}}
